name: eval_v0
description: Synthetic requirement-to-evidence cases. All people, companies and projects are invented. Labels are drafts written by an AI assistant and must be reviewed by a human before numbers are published as final.

requirements.text: Build and deploy machine learning models as REST APIs in production
Experience with Python and scikit-learn
Design evaluation sets and track model metrics
Hands-on experience with Docker
Lead the deployment of models to a cloud platform such as GCP or AWS
Familiarity with Kubernetes
Experience with experiment tracking tools like MLflow
Write SQL to build training datasets
Communicate model results to non-technical stakeholders
Build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for business stakeholders
Write SQL queries against relational databases
Clean and analyze data with Python or Excel
Own weekly KPI reporting for a business unit
Experience with A/B test analysis
Communicate findings to non-technical audiences
Familiarity with dbt
Automate recurring data pipelines
Present sales forecasts to the leadership team
Design and build REST APIs with Python or Go
Experience with PostgreSQL
Own the on-call rotation for production services
Write automated tests and maintain CI pipelines
Experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka
Deploy services with Docker and Kubernetes
Familiarity with Terraform
Use observability tools such as Prometheus or Grafana
Review API designs with product managers
Build batch data pipelines with Airflow
Experience with Spark or another distributed processing engine
Set up model monitoring and data drift alerts
Lead migrations of ML workloads to the cloud
Experience with feature stores
Implement CI/CD for machine learning models
Work with cloud object storage such as S3 or GCS
Familiarity with data privacy regulations such as PIPEDA
Present pipeline costs to finance stakeholders

evidence.text: Built and deployed a FastAPI service that serves a LightGBM model behind a REST endpoint for a clinic's intake app.
Trained classification models in Python with scikit-learn and pandas, comparing logistic regression and gradient boosting baselines.
Created a 400-example evaluation set and reported macro-F1 and per-class recall for every model release.
Contributed to the team's deployment of the service to Google Cloud Run.
Wrote Dockerfiles for the API and a worker, and ran both locally with docker-compose.
Completed an online course covering Kubernetes basics.
Logged experiments in a shared spreadsheet before the team adopted a tracking tool.
Presented SQL query results from the analytics team at weekly meetings.
Built a Tableau dashboard that the operations manager used to track daily fuel deliveries.
Wrote SQL queries in PostgreSQL to reconcile inventory records each month.
Cleaned sales exports in Excel and Python pandas before monthly analysis.
Helped prepare the weekly KPI report that the store manager presented to head office.
Explained inventory variance findings to store staff in short weekly huddles.
Scheduled a Python script with cron to pull and clean the daily sales export.
Updated test data in the staging database for the IT team.
Used scikit-learn in a course project to predict house prices.
Assisted a senior engineer in deploying a model API to AWS.
Read about Docker and containerization while preparing for interviews.
Tracked experiments with MLflow for a capstone model, logging parameters and metrics for each run.
Wrote SQL queries to join patient visit tables into a training dataset for the capstone model.
Designed and built a Go REST API for booking appointments, including authentication and rate limiting.
Modelled the booking schema in PostgreSQL and wrote migrations with golang-migrate.
Joined the on-call rotation in my second month and resolved two paging incidents with a senior engineer.
Added integration tests and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs them on every pull request.
Containerized the API with Docker; the platform team handled the Kubernetes deployment.
Read the Terraform modules the platform team maintained to understand our network setup.
Built Grafana dashboards for API latency using Prometheus metrics.
Built Airflow DAGs that load nightly sales data into BigQuery and retry failed tasks.
Processed 2 TB of clickstream logs with PySpark on Dataproc.
Added a weekly job that compares feature distributions against the training data and emails the team when drift exceeds a threshold.
Led the migration of three training pipelines from on-premise servers to Vertex AI.
Stored model artifacts and raw files in Google Cloud Storage buckets.
Completed the privacy training required for staff handling customer data.
Reviewed a teammate's pull request that added CI checks for a model repository.
Maintained a Flask API for an internal tool, adding three endpoints.
Wrote queries against a MySQL database for the internal tool.
Kafka was listed as a topic in a distributed systems lecture I attended.
Wrote unit tests with pytest for the Flask endpoints.
Checked the team's Grafana dashboard to confirm error rates after deploying a fix.
